_comment: Final slice of the Secure Program Launch residue: ar, he, ja, ko, zh-Hans, zh-TW. Same discipline as the Romance and Germanic batches -- every noun is lifted from the ~32 keys each pack already translated on this same page, so the page reads in one voice. ar credential=اعتماد secret=السر password=كلمة المرور vault=الخزنة launch=تشغيل helper=مساعد. he credential=אישור גישה secret=סוד password=סיסמה vault=כספת launch=השקה session=הפעלה helper=מסייע (the pack itself disambiguates launch/session this way in helpRecordedSession). ja credential=資格情報 secret=秘密 password=パスワード vault=保管庫 launch=起動. ko credential=자격 증명 secret=비밀 password=암호 vault=보관함 launch=실행 helper=도우미. zh-Hans credential=凭据 secret=密钥 password=密码 vault=保险库 launch=启动 helper=桌面助手. zh-TW credential=認證 secret=密鑰 password=密碼 vault=保存庫 launch=啟動 helper=協助程式 port=連接埠 -- note this page says 認證 where other pages say 認證資料; matching the page beats matching the product-wide term. Latin identifiers stay Latin: postgresql, website, PostgreSQL, SSL, SSH, CSS, Playwright, Edge, Chrome, Chromium, Windows, Linux, macOS, the vendor names, the port numbers, the URL scheme, and the product name AIC Secure Launch. helpCommandTemplate keeps single-brace {host}, {port}, {username} byte-identical because the command builder substitutes on those exact spellings. helpPassCss deliberately keeps the literal word password untranslated -- that sentence tells the operator not to give a DOM field that name, so translating it would destroy the instruction. Drafts need native review.

source.secureLaunch.competitorCatalogNote: These match CyberArk, Delinea, and BeyondTrust application launchers. Catalog-only rows store start settings. They do not open a governed session.
source.secureLaunch.definitionStored: Application stored. Start settings are not a secret.
source.secureLaunch.helpAppKind: Kind of application, such as postgresql or website.
source.secureLaunch.helpApplicationName: Name the database sees for this session. Optional.
source.secureLaunch.helpBinary: Program file on the computer that starts it. Empty uses the usual name.
source.secureLaunch.helpBrowserChannel: Installed Edge or Chrome. Chromium is the fallback.
source.secureLaunch.helpCommandTemplate: Start command without a password. {host}, {port}, and {username} are allowed.
source.secureLaunch.helpDatabase: Database name the program opens. Not a password.
source.secureLaunch.helpDisplayName: Operator label for this stored credential. The secret is not the name.
source.secureLaunch.helpExtraArgs: One argument per line. Do not put a password here.
source.secureLaunch.helpInjectStyle: How the helper gives the secret. Never on the command line.
source.secureLaunch.helpKind: Password, SSH key, certificate, or an agent-derived binding.
source.secureLaunch.helpLoginUrl: Sign-in page for a website launch. Leave empty for desktop programs.
source.secureLaunch.helpPassCss: CSS selector for the secret box. Do not name this field password.
source.secureLaunch.helpSecretOnce: Accepted once and stored encrypted. Never listed and never shown again.
source.secureLaunch.helpSlug: Lowercase name for this application. Not a secret.
source.secureLaunch.helpSslmode: PostgreSQL SSL mode. Leave empty to use the application default.
source.secureLaunch.helpSubjectKind: Grant launch to a role or to one principal. No match means deny.
source.secureLaunch.helpSubjectPrincipal: Exact principal identifier. Empty or unknown id cannot launch.
source.secureLaunch.helpSubjectRole: Role label that may launch this application with the chosen credential.
source.secureLaunch.helpSubmitCss: CSS selector for the sign-in button on a Playwright website launch.
source.secureLaunch.helpTargetHost: Host or site the application connects to. Optional rotation match.
source.secureLaunch.helpTargetPort: Service port. Use 5432 for PostgreSQL, 22 for SSH, 0 when unused.
source.secureLaunch.helpUserCss: CSS selector for the username box on a Playwright website launch.
source.secureLaunch.helpUsername: Account name injected at launch. Used to match later password rotation.
source.secureLaunch.helperGrantFailed: Could not open AIC Secure Launch. Install the helper, then launch again. The ticket is ready; the secret is not shown.
source.secureLaunch.helperStarted: AIC Secure Launch opened. It starts the program and keeps the password hidden.
source.secureLaunch.honesty: Launch injects the current password, key, or certificate without showing it. Host, port, database, SSL mode, program path, and web field selectors are stored as start settings and can be changed. A simple website form opens in this browser. A JavaScript sign-in page opens AIC Secure Launch with Playwright. Desktop programs open AIC Secure Launch on this computer. The secret is never listed.

ar.secureLaunch.helperStarted: تم فتح AIC Secure Launch. يبدأ البرنامج ويُبقي كلمة المرور مخفية.

ko.secureLaunch.helpTargetHost: 응용 프로그램이 연결하는 호스트 또는 사이트입니다. 교체 일치는 선택 사항입니다.
ko.secureLaunch.helpTargetPort: 서비스 포트입니다. PostgreSQL은 5432, SSH는 22, 사용하지 않을 때는 0을 입력합니다.
ko.secureLaunch.helpUserCss: Playwright 웹 실행에서 사용자 이름 입력란의 CSS 선택자입니다.
ko.secureLaunch.helpUsername: 실행 시 입력되는 계정 이름입니다. 이후 암호 교체를 일치시키는 데 사용됩니다.
ko.secureLaunch.helperGrantFailed: AIC Secure Launch를 열 수 없습니다. 도우미를 설치한 후 다시 실행하십시오. 티켓은 준비되었으며 비밀은 표시되지 않습니다.
ko.secureLaunch.helperStarted: AIC Secure Launch가 열렸습니다. 프로그램을 실행하고 암호를 숨긴 상태로 유지합니다.
ko.secureLaunch.honesty: 실행 시 현재 암호, 키 또는 인증서를 표시하지 않고 입력합니다. 호스트, 포트, 데이터베이스, SSL 모드, 프로그램 경로, 웹 입력란 선택자는 실행 설정으로 저장되며 변경할 수 있습니다. 단순한 웹 양식은 이 브라우저에서 열립니다. JavaScript 로그인 페이지는 Playwright로 AIC Secure Launch를 엽니다. 데스크톱 프로그램은 이 컴퓨터에서 AIC Secure Launch를 엽니다. 비밀은 목록에 표시되지 않습니다.

zh-Hans.secureLaunch.competitorCatalogNote: 这些与 CyberArk、Delinea 和 BeyondTrust 的应用程序启动器相对应。仅存在于目录中的行会保存启动设置，不会打开受管会话。
zh-Hans.secureLaunch.definitionStored: 应用程序已存储。启动设置不是密钥。
zh-Hans.secureLaunch.helpAppKind: 应用程序类型，例如 postgresql 或 website。
zh-Hans.secureLaunch.helpApplicationName: 本次会话中数据库看到的名称。可选。
zh-Hans.secureLaunch.helpBinary: 启动它的计算机上的程序文件。留空则使用常用名称。
zh-Hans.secureLaunch.helpBrowserChannel: 已安装的 Edge 或 Chrome。Chromium 为备选。
zh-Hans.secureLaunch.helpCommandTemplate: 不含密码的启动命令。可使用 {host}、{port} 和 {username}。
zh-Hans.secureLaunch.helpDatabase: 程序打开的数据库名称。不是密码。
zh-Hans.secureLaunch.helpDisplayName: 此已存储凭据的操作员标签。密钥不是名称。
zh-Hans.secureLaunch.helpExtraArgs: 每行一个参数。请勿在此处填写密码。
zh-Hans.secureLaunch.helpInjectStyle: 助手传递密钥的方式。绝不通过命令行传递。
zh-Hans.secureLaunch.helpKind: 密码、SSH 密钥、证书或由代理派生的绑定。
zh-Hans.secureLaunch.helpLoginUrl: 网站启动的登录页面。桌面程序请留空。
zh-Hans.secureLaunch.helpPassCss: 密钥输入框的 CSS 选择器。请勿将该字段命名为 password。
zh-Hans.secureLaunch.helpSecretOnce: 只接受一次并加密存储。绝不列出，也不再显示。
zh-Hans.secureLaunch.helpSlug: 此应用程序的小写名称。不是密钥。
zh-Hans.secureLaunch.helpSslmode: PostgreSQL SSL 模式。留空则使用应用程序默认值。
zh-Hans.secureLaunch.helpSubjectKind: 将启动权限授予某个角色或某一个主体。不匹配即拒绝。
zh-Hans.secureLaunch.helpSubjectPrincipal: 精确的主体标识。标识为空或未知则无法启动。
zh-Hans.secureLaunch.helpSubjectRole: 可使用所选凭据启动此应用程序的角色标签。
zh-Hans.secureLaunch.helpSubmitCss: Playwright 网站启动中登录按钮的 CSS 选择器。
zh-Hans.secureLaunch.helpTargetHost: 应用程序连接的主机或站点。可选的轮换匹配项。
zh-Hans.secureLaunch.helpTargetPort: 服务端口。PostgreSQL 用 5432，SSH 用 22，不使用时填 0。
zh-Hans.secureLaunch.helpUserCss: Playwright 网站启动中用户名输入框的 CSS 选择器。
zh-Hans.secureLaunch.helpUsername: 启动时注入的账户名。用于匹配后续的密码轮换。
zh-Hans.secureLaunch.helperGrantFailed: 无法打开 AIC Secure Launch。请安装助手，然后重新启动。票证已就绪；不显示密钥。
zh-Hans.secureLaunch.helperStarted: AIC Secure Launch 已打开。它会启动程序并保持密码隐藏。
zh-Hans.secureLaunch.honesty: 启动会注入当前的密码、密钥或证书而不显示它。主机、端口、数据库、SSL 模式、程序路径和网页字段选择器均作为启动设置保存，可以更改。简单的网页表单在此浏览器中打开。使用 JavaScript 的登录页面会通过 Playwright 打开 AIC Secure Launch。桌面程序会在此计算机上打开 AIC Secure Launch。密钥绝不会被列出。

zh-TW.secureLaunch.competitorCatalogNote: 這些與 CyberArk、Delinea 和 BeyondTrust 的應用程式啟動器相對應。僅存在於目錄中的項目會儲存啟動設定，不會開啟受管的工作階段。
zh-TW.secureLaunch.definitionStored: 應用程式已儲存。啟動設定不是密鑰。
zh-TW.secureLaunch.helpAppKind: 應用程式類型，例如 postgresql 或 website。
zh-TW.secureLaunch.helpApplicationName: 本次工作階段中資料庫看到的名稱。選用。
zh-TW.secureLaunch.helpBinary: 啟動它的電腦上的程式檔案。留空則使用慣用名稱。
zh-TW.secureLaunch.helpBrowserChannel: 已安裝的 Edge 或 Chrome。Chromium 為備援。
zh-TW.secureLaunch.helpCommandTemplate: 不含密碼的啟動命令。可使用 {host}、{port} 和 {username}。
zh-TW.secureLaunch.helpDatabase: 程式開啟的資料庫名稱。不是密碼。
zh-TW.secureLaunch.helpDisplayName: 此已儲存認證的操作人員標籤。密鑰不是名稱。
zh-TW.secureLaunch.helpExtraArgs: 每行一個引數。請勿在此填入密碼。
zh-TW.secureLaunch.helpInjectStyle: 協助程式傳遞密鑰的方式。絕不透過命令列傳遞。
zh-TW.secureLaunch.helpKind: 密碼、SSH 金鑰、憑證或由代理程式衍生的繫結。
zh-TW.secureLaunch.helpLoginUrl: 網站啟動的登入頁面。桌面程式請留空。
zh-TW.secureLaunch.helpPassCss: 密鑰欄位的 CSS 選擇器。請勿將此欄位命名為 password。
zh-TW.secureLaunch.helpSecretOnce: 只接受一次並加密儲存。絕不列出，也不再顯示。
zh-TW.secureLaunch.helpSlug: 此應用程式的小寫名稱。不是密鑰。
zh-TW.secureLaunch.helpSslmode: PostgreSQL SSL 模式。留空則使用應用程式的預設值。
zh-TW.secureLaunch.helpSubjectKind: 將啟動權限授予某個角色或單一主體。不相符即拒絕。
zh-TW.secureLaunch.helpSubjectPrincipal: 精確的主體識別碼。識別碼為空或未知時無法啟動。
zh-TW.secureLaunch.helpSubjectRole: 可使用所選認證啟動此應用程式的角色標籤。
zh-TW.secureLaunch.helpSubmitCss: Playwright 網站啟動中登入按鈕的 CSS 選擇器。
zh-TW.secureLaunch.helpTargetHost: 應用程式連線的主機或網站。選用的輪替比對。
zh-TW.secureLaunch.helpTargetPort: 服務連接埠。PostgreSQL 用 5432，SSH 用 22，未使用時填 0。
zh-TW.secureLaunch.helpUserCss: Playwright 網站啟動中使用者名稱欄位的 CSS 選擇器。
zh-TW.secureLaunch.helpUsername: 啟動時填入的帳戶名稱。用於比對後續的密碼輪替。
zh-TW.secureLaunch.helperGrantFailed: 無法開啟 AIC Secure Launch。請安裝協助程式，然後再次啟動。票證已就緒；不會顯示密鑰。
zh-TW.secureLaunch.helperStarted: AIC Secure Launch 已開啟。它會啟動程式並讓密碼保持隱藏。
zh-TW.secureLaunch.honesty: 啟動會填入目前的密碼、金鑰或憑證而不顯示它。主機、連接埠、資料庫、SSL 模式、程式路徑和網頁欄位選擇器都會儲存為啟動設定，並且可以變更。簡單的網頁表單會在此瀏覽器中開啟。使用 JavaScript 的登入頁面會透過 Playwright 開啟 AIC Secure Launch。桌面程式會在此電腦上開啟 AIC Secure Launch。密鑰絕不會被列出。
zh-TW.secureLaunch.sslInherit: 使用應用程式的預設值
zh-TW.secureLaunch.userCss: 使用者名稱欄位選擇器
